import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic

open Finset

/-
We bound the sum `∑ i ≤ k, x i / i` by grouping the indices into blocks
`[j^2, (j+1)^2)`.  Because `x` is non‑increasing, every term in the `j`‑th
block is at most `x (j^2)`.  The block contains at most `2*j+1` indices,
hence

    ∑ i∈[j^2,(j+1)^2) x i / i ≤ (2*j+1) * x (j^2) / (j^2).

Summing over `j = 1,…,⌊√k⌋` gives

    ∑ i≤k x i / i ≤ ∑ j≤⌊√k⌋ (2*j+1) * x (j^2) / (j^2)
                 = 2 * ∑ j≤⌊√k⌋ x (j^2) / j + ∑ j≤⌊√k⌋ x (j^2) / (j^2).

The first sum is bounded by `2` by the hypothesis `hsq`.  Since
`1/(j^2) ≤ 1/j` for `j≥1`, the second sum is bounded by the same
hypothesis, hence by `1`.  Altogether we obtain the desired bound `3`.
-/

  (x : ℕ → ℝ)
  (hpos : ∀ n, 0 < x n)
  (hmono : ∀ n, x n ≥ x (n + 1))
  (hsq : ∀ N, (Ico 1 (N + 1)).sum (fun i => x (i * i) / (i : ℝ)) ≤ 1) :
  ∀ k, (Ico 1 (k + 1)).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) ≤ 3 := by
  intro k
  -- let `m` be the integer part of `√k`
  let m := Nat.sqrt k
  have hk₁ : k < (m + 1) * (m + 1) := by
    have hle : m * m ≤ k := Nat.sqrt_mul_self_le k
    have hlt : k < (m + 1) * (m + 1) := Nat.lt_succ_self _
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hle hlt

  -- non‑negative, so the sum can only increase.
  have hnonneg (i : ℕ) : 0 ≤ x i / (i : ℝ) := by
    have : 0 ≤ x i := le_of_lt (hpos i)
    have : 0 ≤ (i : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le i
    exact div_nonneg this this
  have hsum_le :
      (Ico 1 (k + 1)).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) ≤
        (Ico 1 ((m + 1) * (m + 1))).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) := by
    refine sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?subset hnonneg
    intro i hi
    rcases mem_Ico.1 hi with ⟨hi1, hi2⟩
    have : i ≤ k := Nat.le_of_lt_succ hi2
    exact mem_Ico.2 ⟨hi1, Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt this hk₁⟩
  -- split the large interval into the blocks `[j^2,(j+1)^2)`.
  have hblock :
      (Ico 1 ((m + 1) * (m + 1))).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) =
        (Ico 1 (m + 1)).sum (fun j =>
          (Ico (j * j) ((j + 1) * (j + 1))).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ))) := by
    classical
    refine (sum_natAddEquiv (fun j => Ico (j * j) ((j + 1) * (j + 1))) (by
      intro j hj; exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_mem_Ico hj))

        (Ico 1 (m + 1)).sum (fun j =>

      exact mem_Ico.2 ⟨le_rfl, Nat.lt_succ_self _⟩

      have : ((j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j) = 2 * j + 1 := by
        ring
      have : (Ico (j * j) ((j + 1) * (j + 1))).card = ((j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j) := by
        simpa [card_Ico] using rfl
      simpa [this, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_bit0] using
        le_of_eq (by
          have : ((Ico (j * j) ((j + 1) * (j + 1))).card : ℝ) =

            norm_cast
            exact congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) (card_Ico _ _)
          simpa [this, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_bit0] )
    have hterm :
        (Ico (j * j) ((j + 1) * (j + 1))).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) ≤
          ((Ico (j * j) ((j + 1) * (j + 1))).card : ℝ) *
            (x (j * j) / ((j * j : ℝ))) := by
      refine sum_le_sum_of_nonneg ?_ ?_
      · intro i hi
        have hle : x i ≤ x (j * j) := by
          have : j * j ≤ i := (mem_Ico.1 hi).1
          exact le_of_lt (hmono _).trans_le ?_ -- monotonicity
        have : (x i / (i : ℝ)) ≤ x (j * j) / ((j * j : ℝ)) := by
          have hposi : 0 < (i : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_mem_Ico hi
          have hposj : 0 < ((j * j : ℝ)) := by
            have : 0 < j := Nat.pos_of_mem_Ico hj
            have : 0 < j * j := Nat.mul_pos this this
            exact_mod_cast this
          have : (x i) ≤ x (j * j) := hle

        exact this
      · intro i hi
        have : 0 ≤ x (j * j) / ((j * j : ℝ)) := by
          have : 0 ≤ x (j * j) := le_of_lt (hpos _)
          have : 0 ≤ (j * j : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_le _
          exact div_nonneg this this
        exact this
    have : ((Ico (j * j) ((j + 1) * (j + 1))).card : ℝ) *
            (x (j * j) / ((j * j : ℝ))) ≤
          (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1) * x (j * j) / ((j * j : ℝ)) := by
      nlinarith [hcard]
    exact le_trans hterm this
  -- combine the inequalities
  have htotal :
      (Ico 1 (k + 1)).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) ≤
        (Ico 1 (m + 1)).sum (fun j => (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1) * x (j * j) / ((j * j : ℝ))) := by
    calc
      (Ico 1 (k + 1)).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ))
          ≤ (Ico 1 ((m + 1) * (m + 1))).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) := hsum_le
      _ = (Ico 1 (m + 1)).sum (fun j =>
            (Ico (j * j) ((j + 1) * (j + 1))).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ))) := hblock
      _ ≤ (Ico 1 (m + 1)).sum (fun j =>
            (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1) * x (j * j) / ((j * j : ℝ))) := hblock_le
  -- split the right‑hand side into two sums
  have hsplit :
      (Ico 1 (m + 1)).sum (fun j => (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1) * x (j * j) / ((j * j : ℝ))) =
        (2 : ℝ) * (Ico 1 (m + 1)).sum (fun j => x (j * j) / (j : ℝ)) +
        (Ico 1 (m + 1)).sum (fun j => x (j * j) / ((j * j : ℝ))) := by
    classical
    have : (fun j => (2 * (j : ℝ) + 1) * x (j * j) / ((j * j : ℝ))) =
            fun j => (2 : ℝ) * (x (j * j) / (j : ℝ)) + (x (j * j) / ((j * j : ℝ))) := by
      funext j
      field_simp [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_one] at *
      ring
    simpa [this, sum_add_distrib, sum_mul]

    have := hsq m
    simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.mul_comm] using this
  have hsecond : (Ico 1 (m + 1)).sum (fun j => x (j * j) / ((j * j : ℝ))) ≤ 1 := by
    have hle : (Ico 1 (m + 1)).sum (fun j => x (j * j) / ((j * j : ℝ))) ≤
        (Ico 1 (m + 1)).sum (fun j => x (j * j) / (j : ℝ)) := by
      refine sum_le_sum ?_
      intro j hj
      have : (j : ℝ) ≤ (j * j : ℝ) := by
        have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℝ) := by
          have : 0 < j := Nat.pos_of_mem_Ico hj
          exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt this
        nlinarith
      have : x (j * j) / ((j * j : ℝ)) ≤ x (j * j) / (j : ℝ) := by
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt (hpos _)) this

    exact le_trans hle hfirst
  have : (Ico 1 (k + 1)).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) ≤ 3 := by
    have : (Ico 1 (k + 1)).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) ≤
        (2 : ℝ) * (Ico 1 (m + 1)).sum (fun j => x (j * j) / (j : ℝ)) +
